items.headline: PBOC shifts policy anchor to overnight repo rate, cuts PSL rate 25bp in de facto easing move
items.why: Signals further China monetary easing; supports liquidity/risk appetite for China AI equities like Alibaba, Tencent.

items.headline: Tencent unveils Hy4 open-weight model, claims top-tier China AI performance beating DeepSeek, Z.ai variants
items.why: Shows domestic China model race intensifying; bullish for Tencent AI monetization, competitive pressure on DeepSeek.

items.headline: Anthropic amends S-1, targets Nasdaq debut (ticker ANT) before Thanksgiving at a $1.8-2T valuation
items.why: Would rank among the largest-ever US IPOs, setting a public valuation benchmark for AI labs against OpenAI's $1.25T

items.headline: OpenAI cuts new funding round target by ~$10B to ~$20B amid AI-stock selloff, still eyes $1.25T valuation
items.why: Signals investor caution on AI financing pace even for the top lab; bridge round ahead of a planned 2027 IPO

items.headline: Anthropic's annualized revenue run rate topped $80B in October, up from $65B in July, according to The Wall Street Journal
items.why: Rapid run-rate growth underpins its IPO pitch, but investors are reportedly questioning whether the targeted ~$1.5T valuation is justified

items.headline: Samsung says its 2027 HBM memory supply is already sold out
items.why: Confirms HBM scarcity extending another year, supporting pricing power for memory makers feeding AI chip demand

items.headline: ECB holds deposit rate at 2.50% as eurozone inflation hits 3.8%
items.why: Signals ECB tightening bias into Dec; higher-for-longer EU rates pressure growth-stock multiples incl. AI names

items.headline: Fed holds rates at 3.75%-4.00%; Cook and Hammack dissent wanting a hike as inflation stays elevated
items.why: Hawkish dissent lowers odds of near-term cuts, a headwind for rate-sensitive AI capex financing and growth multiples.

items.headline: SK Hynix says DRAM and HBM capacity is sold out through 2029 amid the AI memory crunch
items.why: Confirms a structural HBM shortage underpinning memory-maker pricing power and a potential AI hardware bottleneck

items.headline: PBOC injects record ~1 trillion yuan overnight liquidity, plus 700bn yuan MLF operation
items.why: Aggressive China liquidity easing supports China AI-equity complex (Alibaba, Tencent) and risk appetite

items.headline: Nvidia to invest $3B and AMD $1B in Meta's $35B stock offering funding its AI data-center buildout
items.why: Chipmakers co-financing their biggest customer's capex deepens the AI capex/vendor-financing loop investors are watching.

items.headline: AMD secures $20B+ commitment from Anthropic for MI450-based Helios AI systems, deliveries from 2027
items.why: Major proof point for AMD as a credible Nvidia alternative in frontier AI training/inference compute

items.headline: SpaceX secures $40B debt financing to lease GPUs as Meta seeks up to $95B AI financing in ~$235B dealmaking day
items.why: Scale of debt-funded AI infrastructure financing raises leverage and returns questions investors must track.

items.headline: Anthropic files S-1 for Nasdaq IPO (ticker ANT), press reports eyeing $1.5T-$2T valuation ahead of roadshow
items.why: Potentially the largest-ever IPO; sets a public valuation benchmark for AI labs and tests investor appetite for AI risk.

items.headline: Broadcom arranges $63B financing deal with BofA, Blackstone, Citi, Morgan Stanley to fund Anthropic's AI chip purchases
items.why: AI infra financing shifting to debt/structured deals; a planned $21B bond sale is a read on credit appetite for AI capex.
